# 13 Camps off the 2:00–10:00 clock face — Black Rock City 2026

Camp placements are official Burning Man Project data and may be shown to users from Aug 23 12:01am (the dataset terms lift the camp-location embargo then; this release ships Aug 27). Playa Pal is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or verified by Burning Man Project.

Camps here are off the 2:00–10:00 clock face (Center Camp Plaza, Airport Road) or listed without a placement.

## ARMÉ - Army of Love

**From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** tall lit tower with large illuminated flag · **Year:** 2026

A camp built around the idea of love as a force that moves people, not a concept. We create a space where connection feels natural, presence matters, and everyone contributes to the atmosphere around them. Our shaded cooling and tea space offers a place to slow down, reset, and share a moment with others in the middle of the chaos. Alongside the camp, we support a large-scale art installation that adds another layer to the experience, inviting people to step into something bigger than themselves. This is a space for real interaction, openness, and the kind of energy you can feel when people actually show up for each other.

*More: http://armeoflove.com*

## Baby Boomer Burners

**From:** Reno Nevada · **Landmark:** "Baby Boomer Burners"... Banner on the Tent · **Year:** 2026

## Black Rock Travel Agency

**Where:** Airport Road · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Starport · **Year:** 2026

The Black Rock Travel Agency is a gang of pilots, aviation enthusiasts, and adventurers who come together every year to serve the airport village and its visitors located at the end of Point5. Yes, there is an airport! BRTA makes it just like you imagine a Burning Man Airport would be. A massive Starport pyramid structure with entertainment and bar underneath with 30 foot viewing platform above? Yes! A super yummy galley serving pancake breakfast and bbq? Yes! Facilitating scenic airplane flights for Burners? Of course! The Agents at the Black Rock Travel Agency are committed to burners having an experience only to be found at the best airport in the world. Start, continue or end your journey with us.

*More: http://blackrocktravelagency.com*

## Camp Ply Curious

**Where:** Center Camp Plaza @ 11:00 · **From:** Murphys · **Landmark:** Big Crossed Question Marks on our shade. · **Year:** 2026

A fun loving semi eccentric group inviting all to experience the unknown. Be loving. Be musical. Be creative. And above all.....be curious!

## Dusk

**From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Big orange sphere in the sky · **Year:** 2026

Psychedelic techno/tech-house inspired by the original sunset parties in Venice Beach, CA.

## Flybynyte

**Where:** Airport Road · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** ctr of the airport village Café with yellow shade · **Year:** 2026

Serving exquisite coffee drinks at the Airport from 8am-noon, Mo-Sat. Come and enjoy our live music and Rainbow Roots Cafe atmosphere while waiting for a flight. Mo-Fri 10am-noon we will have aviation ground school. Our instructors will give you an introduction to aerodynamics, weather, radio communications, avionics, airspace and all things aviation. We can go as easy or as deep as u like - let's learn about flying in a playful way!

## Honey Puddle

**Where:** Center Camp Plaza @ 1:15 · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** shimmering golden fabric and fire-breathing portal · **Year:** 2026

Honey Puddle gives you that warm, sweet, exhilarating feeling of being enveloped by love and friendship. And music and mead and dancing and light. We're not a quiet camp, we're not a not-quiet camp. We're just right...and we'll be here when you want us. We fit like warm pajamas.

## Huǒ Fèng MV Support Camp

**From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Look for Hu? Fèng rising from the Playa · **Year:** 2026

Hu— Fèng rises as a living embodiment of the phoenix spirit. In Chinese symbolism, the phoenix represents the empress - feminine authority, grace, and sovereign power - while fire embodies transformation and rebirth. Together, Hu— Fèng becomes a vessel for renewal in motion. With sculptural wings reaching skyward and a body glowing like flame, it captures the threshold where destruction gives way to creation. Both delicate and powerful, it moves between elegance and intensity. More than a mutant vehicle, Hu— Fèng is an invocation - a call to rise, shed, and remember the strength within softness. It invites participants into transformation, to embody their sovereignty and emerge luminous, expansive, and new.

## Kalos Scopeo

**Landmark:** Silver and blue dolphin camper with dragonflies · **Year:** 2026

## Magic Lantern Society

**Where:** Center Camp Plaza @ 11:30 · **From:** Pacifica, CA · **Landmark:** Garlic-shaped canvas tent · **Year:** 2026

The Magic Lantern is a wandering inn, located at the end of all worlds. Sumptuously-appointed with antiques, curiosities, games, and mysterious old books, we are a space created for deeper human connection, and a warm and inviting sanctuary for the weary and curious traveller. Our centerpiece is our unique Trading Booth, where stories and secrets are the only accepted currency. Anyone can step up to don our shopkeeper's hat?we believe in erasing the boundaries between host and traveller.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/magiclanternsociety/*

## SP Station

**From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Wooden ziggurat and "Mesa" sign out front! · **Year:** 2026

Home station for the SP Express mattress cabana train!

## Vitruvian

**Where:** Center Camp Plaza @ 1:45 · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** 15 ft tall gyroscope, lit at night · **Year:** 2026

Turn your world upside down at Vitruvian Lounge. Enjoy good gyrations by taking a spin on our Human Sized Gyroscope, and stay to enjoy good vibrations in our lounge with great music and ice cold craft cocktails. Head into the K-Box for Korean-style private room karaoke to sing the night away together from 9pm to sunrise.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/camp_vitruvian/*

## Wild Child

**Where:** Center Camp Plaza @ 12:45 · **From:** Bali · **Landmark:** Big black WILD CHILD flag and circus equipment · **Year:** 2026

Run away and join our circus community, hosted by world-class circus artists, where each day is filled with workshops designed to ignite your passion for movement and performance. Explore the world of Aerial hoop, pole dance, partner acrobatics, fire dancing & flow props, parkour, flips and more. Whether you're a seasoned performer or a curious beginner, our inclusive community welcomes all skill levels. Step into Wild Child and join us for an unforgettable circus adventure.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/wildchildbm?igsh=anRrbWt6aDZ2cmVh*
